units.source_text: 惟光带了回信，如实复告源氏公子：

en.t: Koremitsu brought back the reply and reported it faithfully to Prince Genji:

units.source_text: “且待老尼姑病愈，迁回京邸之后，再行奉复。”

en.t: “Please wait until the old nun has recovered from her illness and returned to her residence in the capital; after that, I will send a proper reply.”
Prince Genji felt a deep sadness in his heart.
